fields.name: Baby Sleeping Bag - Jersey - Lovely Birds - Multicolor / 90cm
fields.description: Looking for the ultimate sleeping experience for your little one? All our sleeping bags are made of wonderfully soft and breathable fabric and feature the trendiest prints, specially designed by our design team, so your little one can sleep in style, whatever the season. All sleeping bags also feature a safe and comfortable zip to make putting them on and taking them off as easy as possible. So from newborn minis to mischievous toddlers and from balmy summers to cold winters, we'll make sure your little one sleeps soundly! Shop this sleeping bag with TOG value 0.5 in different colours and in sizes 70, 90 and 110 cm! So you're sure to find the perfect fit for your little one.

fields.name: Blanket - Jungle Jambo - Ash Green / 75x100 cm
fields.short_description: This blanket is a real eye-catcher in the nursery! With the beautiful colours Biscuit/Oatmeal or Ash Green/Laurel you can wear this blanket on both sides and this blanket is therefore completely reversible. The fabric is 100% cotton and the filling is polyester. Introduce your child to all the animals on this cosy print and combine this blanket with the other items from the Jungle Jambo collection! This blanket has a TOG value of 2.
